clip.permission: generated by this project; no third-party footage involved

queue_series.compares_against: region occupancy (vehicles inside the polygon, any speed)

queue_length_app_definition.compares_against: queued (inside polygon AND below speed threshold for >= min_queue_seconds)

reference_notes: Ground truth rebuilt from the simulator's own per-vehicle positions. occupancy_counts applies the same purely geometric rule as the application's region occupancy series (inside the region, any speed, no hold), so it is the like-for-like ground truth for a hand-taken count. queue_counts applies the 'inside the region and below the speed threshold' rule as the analytics do and is the ground truth for the slow count. It validates the measurement layer only and says nothing about detector accuracy.
